notes.title: v1.3.1 - Loadout, Powerups, Achievements, Bug Fixes, and General Improvements
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Reworked the loadout system. There are now 3 tiers of powerups and after tier 1, players are unable to combine multiple powerups within the same tier.
[*] If your existing loadouts contain conflicting powerups, they will be automatically removed.
[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/981273807803256902/1131960197615726652/Loadout_tiers.png?width=1404&height=910[/img]

[*] Achievements and their fun little icons (Thanks FreshFromTheGrave) have been added to the game. More to come.
[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/981273807803256902/1131960198517502093/Achievements.png[/img]

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/981273807803256902/1131960198030954507/Siphon.png[/img]
[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/981273807803256902/1131960198265831514/Reverse_and_Flip.png[/img]

[/list]

notes.title: v1.3.0 - Type Through Errors!
notes.notes:
Added the option to type through errors. This is not default. You will need to toggle this in order for it to be active. 

Players will not be able to win if they have not fixed their typos.

With this setting enabled, the prompt will display the incorrect characters you've typed and allow you to backspace them until you return to the character you're supposed to type.

You can change this setting at any time in the Main Menu under Options -> Settings -> Type Through Errors.

notes.title: v1.2.0 - 1/6/2023
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added ability to enter your build specs: Keyboard, Switches, Keycaps. These will be shown on your profile card on leaderboards. You can set this up in the Main Menu under Options -> Build
[*] Added leaderboards. These leaderboards will consist of average WPM, Accuracy, and Character Interval. There is also a leaderboard for the fastest character interval as well and most games won.
[*] Character Interval is a metric I've used when developing the bots and figured it would be a nice way to gauge typing speed without worrying about variances in word length. It is the average time between each accurately typed character in the prompt.
[/list]

notes.title: Launch Day
notes.notes:
Welcome to early access! Thank you to everyone who purchased our game. We're overjoyed by the positive feedback and after playing alongside everyone, reading bug reports, and taking our own notes, we're getting back to work.

There seems to be a bit of an issue locking lobbies, which can cause some problems if players are able to join too close to the start of the game. It can break the game for the player that joined late. That's priority #1 for me right now. 

Another thing we've seen a lot of people request is a vanilla racing mode. We plan to implement in-lobby voting for the text source and game effects. They will be randomized but the players will always have 2 choices to vote between. 

We plan to rotate certain game modes with a guaranteed game effect as well. This will be available as one of the options in the Main Menu. I think those who requested the vanilla racing mode will be happy to hear that our first implementation will be barebones - a mode that is guaranteed to have powerups disabled. This mode could still have other game effects applied and the prompt could be derived from novels or randomly generated. 

We'll rotate these game modes due to the concurrent player count. If we reach a solid player base and don't have to worry about lobbies filling up, we may implement more game modes permanently rather than rotating them.

We have a lot of work ahead of us and are excited about the features we plan to implement in the future! We'll keep you in the loop as we develop them and would love to hear your feedback and suggestions. 

Thank you again to everyone who is participating in early access and helping the game reach its full potential. We still have plenty of ideas and hope everyone enjoys the game as much as we do!
